feed.title: CARLISLE COMPANIES (NYSE: CSL) Director Singh Jesse G Executes Option Exercise and Reports 505-Share Sale
feed.summary: On September 10, 2026, CARLISLE COMPANIES INC (NYSE: CSL) Director Singh Jesse G exercised options for 4,070 shares at $329.74 per share, converting all his derivative securities. Following this, he sold 505 shares, reducing his total reported holdings to 8,247 shares from an initial 8,752 post-exercise. This transaction eliminated his derivative securities position and represented a sale of approximately 5.8% of his post-exercise holdings.

feed.title: AdaptHealth at Jefferies conference: focus shifts to scale and capitation
feed.summary: AdaptHealth discussed its business transformation at the Jefferies Healthcare Services and Technology Conference, shifting from an acquisition-led model to a focused approach on sleep health, respiratory care, and home medical equipment. The company highlighted new challenges such as a manufacturing price change and a difficult Kaiser Permanente contract rollout, alongside benefits from portfolio cleanup and national scale. AdaptHealth aims to become a preferred national provider by leveraging technology, strategic partnerships, and focusing on organic growth in its core segments, expecting mid-single-digit growth in sleep health.

Lukes, noted a continued strong pipeline of opportunities.

feed.title: Ford recalls nearly a quarter-million F-150 trucks over scary fuel tank hazard
feed.summary: Ford is recalling 223,472 F-150 pickup trucks from model years 2023-2027 due to improperly attached front fuel tank straps that could cause the tank to detach. This defect poses severe safety risks, including fire hazards from leaking fuel and dangerous road obstacles if a tank detaches while driving. Ford will notify affected owners by letter starting September 21st, and dealerships will inspect and replace the straps free of charge.

feed.title: Darden's Earnings Trajectory Seen Improving as Olive Garden Trends Accelerate, Oppenheimer Says
feed.summary: Oppenheimer expects Darden Restaurants (DRI) to experience an improved earnings trajectory, driven by accelerating trends at its Olive Garden brand. The article suggests that this positive momentum at Olive Garden will contribute to overall better financial performance for Darden.

feed.title: Chubb Sued by Call Center Over Adidas Cyber Breach Settlement
feed.summary: A Wisconsin call center company, Alta Resources Corp., has sued a Chubb Ltd. unit, alleging breach of contract and bad faith after the insurer denied coverage for a cybersecurity breach settlement with Adidas AG. Alta Resources Corp. had paid over $5 million to settle claims from Adidas regarding hackers accessing customer data through Alta employees' credentials. Chubb’s Ace American Insurance Co. acknowledged the cyber incident was covered but allegedly denied coverage based on wrongful contract exclusions.

feed.title: Valero Stock Up 140%, On Track For Best Year In Its History - Valero Energy (NYSE:VLO)
feed.summary: Valero Energy Corp. (NYSE: VLO) has seen its stock climb 140.6% year-to-date, putting it on track for its best year ever, surpassing 2005's record. This surge is largely attributed to a diesel squeeze, with the ultra-low-sulfur diesel crack spread near $106 a barrel due to disruptions, Russian export bans, and winter restocking. Valero and Marathon Petroleum Corp. (NYSE: MPC) have both doubled refining margins and are among the top-performing S&P 500 stocks.

feed.title: Skyworks Solutions Stock Tops S&P 500. The Apple Supplier Picks Up Where It Left Off.
feed.summary: Skyworks Solutions stock emerged as the top performer in the S&P 500 today, demonstrating a strong rebound despite a broader selloff in artificial intelligence-related stocks. As a key supplier to Apple, Skyworks Solutions' performance highlights its resilience in the market.

feed.title: Delek US (NYSE:DK) Shares Up 4.7% Following Analyst Upgrade

The company reported strong quarterly results with EPS of $5.48 against estimates of $2.67 and a 47.9% year-over-year revenue increase. Despite general analyst positivity, insiders have sold over $10.7 million worth of stock in the last 90 days.

feed.title: Microsoft Adds Brand Kit and New AI Skills to Copilot in PowerPoint
feed.summary: Microsoft is enhancing Copilot in PowerPoint with new "Brand Kit" and "Skills" features. Brand Kit allows Copilot to access and apply an organization's visual identity when generating presentations, ensuring brand consistency. The new Skills expand Copilot's capabilities beyond simple slide generation, making it a more comprehensive tool for building business presentations within Microsoft 365.

feed.title: Smartphone Chip Stocks Rally While Large-Cap Technology Slips: Skyworks Jumps 11%, Qorvo Rises 7%, Qualcomm Climbs 4%
feed.summary: Smartphone chip stocks like Skyworks, Qorvo, and Qualcomm saw significant rallies, with Skyworks jumping 11%, Qorvo rising 7%, and Qualcomm climbing 4%, despite a broader slip in large-cap technology. This divergence highlights a shift in semiconductor investment towards handset-focused radio frequency (RF) chip names, driven by factors like pending mergers and seasonal product launches rather than AI data center spending. The rally for these specific stocks suggests a distinct market movement independent of the broader tech sector's performance.

feed.title: FedEx Expands Sustainable Aviation Fuel Agreements Across U.S. Air Network
feed.summary: FedEx has expanded its sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) procurement through new agreements set to secure over 20 million gallons of neat SAF across five U.S. airports by 2027. These agreements will result in SAF blend ratios of 30% to 50% and are a significant step towards FedEx's goal of sourcing 30% of jet fuel from alternative sources by 2030, supporting its broader aim for carbon-neutral global operations by 2040. The company emphasizes SAF's role in decarbonization and its commitment to stimulating market growth for reliable and affordable SAF.

feed.title: Simon Unleashes Its Biggest Ad Campaign
feed.summary: Simon Property Group has launched its largest-ever advertising campaign, "It's a Simon Thing," across all its U.S. properties and digital platforms. The campaign aims to celebrate the diverse and memorable personal experiences shoppers have at Simon's malls, outlets, and lifestyle centers, expanding beyond its previous Gen Z-focused efforts. It features a flexible tagline to tailor messages for different properties and platforms, supported by a 60-second video spot and a comprehensive digital and social media push.

feed.title: F5 Distributed Cloud Bot Defense Adds Device Intelligence and Agentic AI detection to Guard Against Automated Account Abuse
feed.summary: F5 (NASDAQ: FFIV) has enhanced its Distributed Cloud Bot Defense with new device intelligence capabilities and agentic AI protections. These updates provide persistent device context and continuous risk decisioning to application security, helping organizations manage real-time agent interactions to prevent automated fraud and abuse while allowing legitimate digital interactions. The new features address the challenges posed by advanced AI agents that perform multi-step actions, offering a multi-signal approach to distinguish between authorized AI and malicious bots.

feed.title: RTX's Pratt & Whitney completes F135 Engine Core Upgrade Risk Reduction Design Review
feed.summary: Pratt & Whitney, an RTX business, has successfully completed the F135 Engine Core Upgrade (ECU) Risk Reduction Design Review (RRDR), a crucial milestone that validates the design's maturity and moves the program closer to production. This upgrade is essential for supporting advanced sensors, weapons, and other Block 4 capabilities for the F-35 Lightning II. The ECU leverages the existing F135 architecture, ensuring cost-effectiveness and sustained fleet readiness for decades.

feed.title: RBC Capital lowers McDonald’s stock price target on estimate cuts By Investing.com

The firm also anticipates details on an upcoming remodel program. Despite the price target cut, InvestingPro analysis suggests the stock is currently undervalued, and McDonald's has a strong dividend history.

feed.title: Realty Income (O) Forms European Joint Venture To Expand Net Lease Reach
feed.summary: Realty Income (O) and KKR have established a new European net lease joint venture to expand Realty Income's reach in key markets and increase its exposure to tenants outside public markets. This partnership is a long-horizon vehicle, aligning with Realty Income's strategy for private capital and global diversification. The venture is expected to close on September 30, 2026, and its success will depend on the redeployment of €528m in proceeds into new assets and its impact on occupancy and AFFO per share.

feed.title: TD Cowen reiterates Buy on Vera Therapeutics stock on kidney data By Investing.com
feed.summary: TD Cowen reaffirmed its Buy rating and $78.00 price target for Vera Therapeutics (NASDAQ: VERA) after the company released positive two-year data from its ORIGIN3 trial for IgAN treatment. The data indicated that Trutakna stabilized kidney function and improved disease progression, showing a numerically superior benefit compared to a competitor drug. Despite a year-to-date decline, the stock has gained 40% over the past year, and analysts maintain a Strong Buy consensus.

feed.title: Chevron’s CEO Thinks the World Is Out of Spare Oil. He Is Betting $7 Billion on Being Right.
feed.summary: Chevron's CEO, Mike Wirth, believes that the world's emergency oil reserves are depleted and cannot be replenished indefinitely, making crude oil vulnerable to disruptions. To back this conviction, Chevron is investing $7 billion in a Venezuelan expansion project, aiming to more than double output there, funded entirely by in-country cash flow. This strategy allows Chevron to capitalize on potential oil shortages without diverting capital from other key projects, positioning the company favorably amidst rising oil prices and resilient demand.

feed.title: Salesforce Slips as Dreamforce Puts Its $3.9 Billion AI Engine on Trial
feed.summary: Salesforce's shares slipped as its Dreamforce conference highlighted AI's central role in its product roadmap. Investors are keen to see if the company's significant AI investments, including its "AIforce" and "Koa" models, will translate into accelerated, sustainable growth, moving beyond experimentation to become a substantial business line. Despite a valuation gap suggesting it's undervalued, the company needs to assure investors that AI adoption will expand its growth rather than just reallocate existing software spending.

feed.title: Why Is Lowe’s Companies (NYSE:LOW) Under Pressure Now?
feed.summary: Lowe's Companies (NYSE:LOW) is facing market pressure, hitting a new yearly low amidst a shifting retail landscape. The company's performance is influenced by consumer spending patterns, housing market activity, and overall economic conditions, impacting demand for home improvement products. While earnings per share exceeded estimates, sales were below, highlighting the need for efficient operations and cost management as the market re-evaluates consumer-focused businesses.

feed.title: Sherwin-Williams unveils 2027 color of the year as trend forecasts begin to arrive

feed.title: Skyworks Solutions Jumps 9.5% Amid Sector-Wide Rally

This surge, accompanied by gains in peers like QRVO and SMTC, suggests a renewed investor interest in the semiconductor space rather than company-specific news. The rally brought Skyworks' market capitalization to $13.0 billion, highlighting significant single-day gains and potential institutional participation.

feed.title: Could American International (NYSE:AIG) Leadership Shift Change the Story?
feed.summary: American International Group (NYSE:AIG) is currently navigating a significant period marked by a leadership transition and a new fixed-income financing initiative involving callable, subordinated, and unsecured Eurobond notes. This confluence of events brings renewed market attention to the global insurer's governance, capital structure, valuation, and operational efficiency. The article delves into how these developments, combined with AIG's expansive insurance operations and financial performance, will shape its future trajectory within the financial sector.

feed.title: F5 Announces Enhancements to Distributed Cloud Bot Defense with Device Intelligence and Agentic Ai Protections
feed.summary: F5 has announced significant enhancements to its Distributed Cloud Bot Defense, integrating new device intelligence capabilities and specialized agentic AI protections. These updates aim to provide continuous risk decisioning and persistent device context, helping organizations differentiate between trusted digital interactions and automated fraud. Key features include persistent device identification, real-time device risk scoring, risk-based workflow enforcement, and an agent-aware policy framework to manage human and AI agent traffic effectively.

feed.title: 3M Co. (MMM) expects higher oil costs to be offset dollar-for-dollar through pricing, with no impact on earnings
feed.summary: 3M Co. (MMM) anticipates that increased oil costs will be entirely counterbalanced by adjustments in product pricing, ensuring that these cost fluctuations will not negatively affect the company's earnings. The article is a premium-only piece, requiring a subscription to read the full content.

feed.title: Chipotle Falls 5%: Profit Taking After a Strong Month, or the Salmonella Headline Again?
feed.summary: Chipotle stock dropped 5% on Tuesday without any specific company news, leading to speculation between profit-taking after a strong month or renewed fears about past salmonella headlines. Despite the fall, the stock remains up 5% for the month, and the CDC had previously confirmed no ongoing consumer risk from a summer salmonella outbreak. The decline appears to be stock-specific, as broader markets and quick-service restaurant peers experienced much smaller drops.

feed.title: SaverOne completes first phase of Cemex Germany truck rollout By Investing.com
feed.summary: SaverOne 2014 Ltd. has completed the initial phase of installing its Driver Distraction Prevention System in Cemex Germany's truck fleet, following a previous deployment in Cemex's passenger cars in 2025. This rollout signifies a vote of confidence in SaverOne's technology, with mutual intentions to expand the system across Cemex's global fleets. Cemex plans to continue installations in its remaining German trucks and pursue deployments in other regions.

feed.title: Dealmaking is super active and we don't see it slowing down, says Morgan Stanley's John Collins
feed.summary: John Collins, Morgan Stanley global co-head of M&A, stated that dealmaking is currently very active and he does not anticipate a slowdown. He discussed the strong appetite for M&A activity and provided insights into future expectations. The article highlights his perspective on the ongoing robust trend in mergers and acquisitions.

feed.title: Carter’s is getting a makeover. The 161-year-old children’s brand unveils new logo and slogan
feed.summary: Carter's, the 161-year-old children's apparel brand, is undergoing a major rebranding initiative. This includes the introduction of a new logo and a new slogan as part of a significant makeover. The changes aim to refresh the brand's image while maintaining its long-standing legacy.

feed.title: Coya Therapeutics Announces Enrollment of 100th Participant in Phase 2/3 ALSTARS Trial of COYA 302 for the Treatment of ALS
feed.summary: Coya Therapeutics has announced the enrollment of its 100th participant in the Phase 2/3 ALSTARS Trial for COYA 302, a treatment for Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS). The company anticipates completing full enrollment of 120 participants in the coming weeks, with topline data expected in early Q2 2027. COYA 302, which has FDA Fast Track designation, aims to enhance regulatory T-cell function and suppress inflammation in neurodegenerative disorders.

feed.title: D.A. Davidson reiterates Custom Truck One Source stock rating on bullish outlook
feed.summary: D.A. Davidson reiterated a Buy rating and $13.00 price target for Custom Truck One Source (NYSE:CTOS) after virtual meetings with management indicated a more bullish outlook for the company. Despite a recent 25% decline, the stock is up 53% year-to-date, and management expressed increased confidence in deleveraging and improving returns. This positive sentiment follows Custom Truck One Source's record-breaking revenue and earnings in Q2 2026, surpassing Wall Street expectations.

feed.title: Oracle (NYSE: ORCL) Stock Price Drops On Capital Spending Fears While Palo Alto Networks (NASDAQ: PANW) And ServiceNow (NYSE: NOW) Surge
feed.summary: Oracle (NYSE: ORCL) shares dropped 3.7% due to capital spending concerns and Larry Ellison's cancellation of a $7.5 billion stock-sale program. In contrast, ServiceNow (NYSE: NOW) surged 7.4% as investors reconsidered AI's threat to enterprise software, and Palo Alto Networks (NASDAQ: PANW) gained 13.1% amidst rising demand for cybersecurity solutions against AI-enabled threats. Meanwhile, Bank of America (NYSE: BAC) fell 5.1% after its CEO predicted a significant decline in investment-banking fees.

feed.title: DuPont, Chemours, Corteva ink $590M PFAS settlement with North Carolina
feed.summary: DuPont, Chemours, and Corteva have agreed to a $590 million settlement with North Carolina to resolve claims that they contaminated the state's environment with PFAS "forever chemicals." This settlement, the largest environmental damages recovery in North Carolina's history, addresses contamination from the Fayetteville Works plant and firefighting foam. It also resolves an appeal before the North Carolina Supreme Court regarding the Attorney General's authority to pursue such claims.

feed.title: Republic Services 10% Owner Trades $129.31M In Company Stock
feed.summary: CASCADE INVESTMENT LLC, a 10% owner of Republic Services (NYSE: RSG), made an insider purchase of 580,810 shares totaling $129.31 million. This transaction indicates confidence in the waste management company, which reported a revenue growth of 4.6% and a high gross margin of 42.14% as of June 30, 2026. Despite a higher-than-average debt-to-equity ratio, the company's P/E ratio suggests a discounted valuation.

feed.title: Starwood Capital Group Hires Blackstone’s Michael Eglit as U.S. Head of Originations
feed.summary: Starwood Capital Group has appointed Michael Eglit, formerly of Blackstone, as its new head of U.S. originations. Eglit's move strengthens Starwood Capital's debt business, building on existing relationships and aiming to expand into new loan portfolios. This hire follows Jonathan Pollack, another former Blackstone colleague, joining Starwood as president 17 months prior.

feed.title: Jim Cramer Questions TJX After Marmaxx Stumbles
feed.summary: Jim Cramer expressed significant concern over TJX Companies, particularly its Marmaxx division (TJ Maxx and Marshalls), after its recent weak sales performance. Despite management claiming to have identified and fixed the issues without disclosing specifics, Cramer found this infuriating, especially given Ross Stores' stronger performance. He highlighted the difficulty of owning retail stocks due to external factors like discretionary income and internal merchandising problems, while acknowledging TJX's historical strength.

feed.title: Columbia Banking System at Barclays conference: discipline drives gains
feed.summary: Columbia Banking System (COLB) emphasized a disciplined and selective strategy at the Barclays 24th Annual Global Financial Services Conference, focusing on balance-sheet optimization, fee growth, and technology improvements rather than aggressive volume expansion in a competitive market. The bank is benefiting from a gradual runoff of legacy loans and is using AI to enhance efficiency, particularly in its call center and fraud detection. Management also highlighted a strong capital return program and a focus on deeper commercial relationships, while noting that M&A is not currently a priority.

feed.title: Cosmos Health Adds 5.2 Million Units in New Five-Year Agreements with Target Pharma; Orderbook Surges Past 32.7 Million Units, Up 31% Since June
feed.summary: Cosmos Health Inc.'s subsidiary, Cana Laboratories S.A., has secured new five-year manufacturing agreements with Target Pharma for approximately 5.2 million units, focusing on dermatology and anti-infective products. This boosts Cana's orderbook to over 32.7 million units, a 31% increase since June 2026, and expands its therapeutic coverage to 11 categories. The company expects this growth to contribute to over $10 million in recurring annual profit at full capacity, demonstrating a significant step change in the division's scale.
